specification.stopping_and_calibration: each preceding 90 days; training is expanding history before stopping
specification.purge: label settled at time+7d plus one-day embargo before any later segment
specification.target: normalized forward log return z=(p[t+h]-p[t])/(s_t*sqrt(h)); UP if z>0.75, DOWN if z<-0.75, else NEUTRAL
specification.risk_scale: EWMA of squared daily log returns, halflife 21 days, floor 1e-6, frozen per decision

models.logit: multinomial logistic, C chosen on stopping from [0.01, 0.1, 1.0], standardized
models.xgb: multi:softprob, depth chosen from [2, 3], min_child_weight 10, eta .05, early stopping on stopping (20 rounds, 256 max)

specification.calibration: one temperature on calibration rows; alarms use the calibration quantile of max(P_up, P_down)

alarm.episode: maximal run of consecutive origins with same nonzero primary label

costs.entry: open 1 4h bar after decision close; delayed 7 bars
costs.funding: realized 4h funding settlements inside the hold

specification.bootstrap: circular daily blocks 21 primary; [14, 35] sensitivity; 2000 draws

verdict_rules.FORECAST_PROMISING: logit_price log-loss gain vs all four baselines has CI95 lower > 0 and positive in all test years
verdict_rules.FORECAST_WEAK: all four point gains positive but not PROMISING
verdict_rules.TRADING_PROMISING: primary entry net mean CI95 lower > 0 at 20% coverage
verdict_rules.TRADING_WEAK: primary net mean positive but CI includes zero
verdict_rules.POINT/LOWER_BOUND_80: precision point and CI lower >= .8 are reported as separate flags

specification.trial_status: first run of this protocol; prior regime and onset results are not reused as evidence

funding_source_verification.method: Binance monthly archives; local ZIP cache SHA-256 checked
